about.title: About Us
about.tagline: The only thing we're serious about is food.
about.description: We bring together the rich flavours of Indian cuisine, from crispy South Indian breakfasts to aromatic biryanis, delicious starters and traditional Indian desserts. Our menu combines authentic flavours with a modern dining experience, allowing customers to explore their favourite dishes and create their own meal combinations.
